United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)

description.narrative: The project aims at developing a nation-wide online platform that serves all 27 universities in Libya. The online platform will act as a digital gateway for students, faculty and staff to have Open Access information including Open Educational Resources from around the world and those developed in Libya. The platform will also become part e-learning hub which will serve as a repository and learning management system (LMS) to support capacity building actions for the students, faculty and staff of Libyan universities . This capacity building will include digital competencies of Digital Planning and Design, Data Use and Governance, as well as Digital Management and Execution. In ensure long term success of the digital transformation of Libyan universities, decided actions to develop nation-wide policy and strategies which will guide its development for years guided by UNESCO’s Guidance for Generative AI in Education and Research, the Artificial Intelligence and Digital Transformation Competencies for Civil Servants (2022), and the Recommendation on Open Educational Resources (2019).
